nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So, you ready to practice?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Absolutely! Let's run some lines!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Right. Let's, uh, let's run them. Whatever that means.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You've read the script, right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sounds good, man. Sounds good. And I know just the person you should start with!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Great! Actors are nothing without an audience! I bet there's tons of people in school who haven't bought tickets!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wanna come with me?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Absolutely not!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Whatever. Look, are you going to help me or not?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: If you did... You'd make me really, really, really happy...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... In that case... Yeah... I suppose, I will. Is this going to be hard?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Of course not! Acting is as easy as can be! And don't worry. The play is totally easy to learn!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We're putting on 'Spamlet', the great tragedy by Wilford Shlockspeare! But it's not all that boring, old English stuff...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Andrew, our playwright, has adapted it into a musical!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That doesn't sound easy at all! What if I can't learn how to...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'll email you the script right now! Head down to the auditorium as soon as you print it out!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: She hung up.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You know, sometimes I really feel like Hannah takes me for granted...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's why I've got to do a great job in this play! If I impress her now, then she'll really start to appreciate me!

nodes.text: Brendanimal! Where are you?! We're dying in here!!!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, Hannah? I'm here...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Brendan! You made it!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm so glad you came!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, of course! We're friends, right?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Best friends! So... Are you ready to do some acting?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure! Let's read some lines. Run some lines. Line some reeds.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't really know any theater terms...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, you're gonna have to learn fast! There's only nine school days until the play opens!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, Hannah! Is this the guy who's gonna be helping us out with Owen's part?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yep! Brendan, this is Hector, our director. He'll fill you in on what you need to do!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... I thought... I'd spend time with you...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Are you kidding? I've got to spend all afternoon trying on my costume! Geez!
Hannah shoves by Brendan and runs offstage.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Eh, I wouldn't worry about her. You're really saving our butts by helping us with this play... I'm sure she appreciates it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I hope so...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Listen up. If you're going to fill Owen's size-12 shoes, you'll need to do three things.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: First, you're going to have to learn your lines, and learn how to deliver them convincingly. Don't worry... We'll help you with that!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Learn lines, deliver lines. I can do that.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Next, you're gonna have to get to know the cast.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Good chemistry is vital to good acting!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Get to know the cast... I guess I can do that...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And finally, you're going to have to sell some tickets!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sell tickets? Can't Owen sell tickets with a broken leg?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's a really bad break, dude.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... Sorry. I guess I'll sell his tickets, then.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So... You've got nine school days to rehearse your part, get friendly with the cast, and sell plenty of tickets!

nodes.text: What do you want to do today?

nodes.text: What are you talking about? You're great in math class! You're so confident... And bold... And exciting...

nodes.text: If you just acted in this play, I bet all the girls in school would be all over you!

nodes.text: Oh ghost! Why doth thou entrance me with thy countenance?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: My prince, I bring the most ominous of tidings! Thy father was slain by thine uncle!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh terrible visage! Oh wicked apparition! Art thou for reals?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: YES, MY PRINCE, I AM FOR REALS!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aaaaaaand scene!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How was that?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Awesome, man, awesome! You're a real natural!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Good to know!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Verily, my prince, canst thou not ameliorate this conflict?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... I... canst... vexinate... thoust... face.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't think that's right...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I mean... My... Kindleroggen... Willst... Uh... Perlocation... Transcinode... Venterdog.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Was that right?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe in German.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe you should go home and practice by yourself for a while. This isn't really getting us anywhere.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ooh, sweet prince, tell me, dost thou heart still beat?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Aye, fair Orphalia, it beats...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: With hate!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: With sorrow!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's bad!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But above all else... With love.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Aww. I love thee too, my sweet, sweet prince.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Am I, uh, walking in on something?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah... Brendan acing his delivery!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You really picked a winner, Hannah... This guy's got talent.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just happy to help!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Slay me then, oh wretched prince! End my torment!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay. Prepare to die.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Stab stab stab. Now thou art dead.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Really? That's `really` the best you got?
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? That's [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] the best you got?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Was it not good?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I mean, maybe if you think the play is about robots...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's not?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Just go home and work on your delivery, man.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...Okay...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That was me singing...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm... I'm so sorry.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You don't have to apologize.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No... I'm sorry... For you. I had no idea you were so awful!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Maybe you ought to go home and practice your singing... And don't trust that video game!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess not...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh... Right... It's a musical...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's right! How's your singing voice?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... I once got called a 'Singing Sensation'...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...By the judges in 'Krazy Karaoke' for the WeeBox 360!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well... Let's see what you've got! Why don't you sing the fourth song in the play, `Toby or not Toby?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well... Let's see what you've got! Why don't you sing the fourth song in the play, [color=#e23b3b][i]Toby or not Toby?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Here goes...
Brendan heads to the theater.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hey, Hector! What've you got in store for me today?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, we've run your lines and practiced your acting. There's only one thing left...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Your singing skills!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You ready to run some more lines?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Actually... I was thinking we could work on your expressiveness.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Expressiveness?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, man, expressiveness! Here, let me show you something. Say 'Prepare to die, traitor!'

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Prepare to die, traitor?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, see, you can say it like that... Or you can say it like this!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: PREPARE TO DIE, TRAITOR!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: See? That's acting right there. You ready to try reading your lines with a little more emotion?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure!
Brendan heads to the theater.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, man!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh, sort of. There's one little problem though. I skimmed through it... But I don't understand half the words!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, yeah, man, it's Shlockspearean English... What did you expect?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: How am I supposed to memorize lines I don't understand?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'd probably start by understanding them! Come on... I bet you can guess some of their definitions!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Hmm... Let's see here...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Anyone else here?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Nope! Just me!
Brendan loses another afternoon to gossip and girl-talk with Hannah!

nodes.speaker: Brendan

Brendan lunges forward, waving the sword around and making beamsaber noises!

nodes.text: Take that, young Skystalker! I am your... Father!
Jacob shakes his head skeptically and presses his cell phone to his ear.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hold on a sec. I've got 1992 on the line here. They want their pop culture reference back.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Come on. Is that really the best you can do?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess I'm not that hip, huh?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Seriously. Stick to the scripts, man.
Brendan presses the cardboard tube to his lips and blows into it, making a loud trumpet noise!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Make way, make way! The emperor is here! Just don't say anything about his new clothes!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ha ha! Yeah, man! Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: To be honest, I was kind of testing you... Most people just do something dumb like pretend it's a sword!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh! That... Uh... Never even crossed my mind!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Good times, good times. I like your style, Brendan.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I, uh, like your cardboard tube.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm going to need that back.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure, sure.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Anyway, I gotta get going, but it was great meeting you, man! We should get together some time and work on our comedy!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow, theater people are really weird... But at least things are going well!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah, you! You're the new guy playing the lead in the play, right?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah... But who are you?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I'm Jacob! I'm in the play... Playing the fat, funny guy, Falsestaff.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I haven't seen you at any rehearsals...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Well, you know... It's not a big part, and I'm not really big on rehearsal. I like to improv!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh. Well, that's cool, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Yeah? You like improv too? Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, I wouldn't say that I...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Here, let's do some right now!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh?
Jacob reaches into his backpack and tosses Brendan a long cardboard tube!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Go!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Uh...
Brendan makes his way towards the auditorium when...

nodes.text: Hey! You! Guy!

nodes.text: Yeah? Like what?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well... Uh... There was that one time... When she... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Okay, so I can't think of anything! But that doesn't mean they didn't happen!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Look, man, I'm happy you're helping us with this play. Really, I am.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: But I think you gotta learn to stick up for yourself! Don't let anyone push you around!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't need your advice, okay?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, man. Whatever. Sorry I said anything.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: The nerve of that guy! I'm gonna show him! I'm gonna quit this stupid play!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No, no, no I'm not. Hannah would be so upset!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: ...I wonder if maybe he had a point...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess I have done a lot of big favors for her over the years...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Brendan! I need your help! You have to play in this soccer game for me!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I don't know how to play soccer!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Brendan! I need your help! You have to take my shift making pizzas!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I don't know how to cook!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Brendan! I need your help! You have to take my place in the bikini contest!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I'm a guy!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Aw man, Hector. You really think our friendship is that lopsided?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I don't wanna judge, man. I'm just saying you ought to stick up for yourself. Be your own man.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Maybe you're right, Hector. Maybe you're right.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll see you around, okay? It was good talking to you.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Catch you later!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, man! What's up?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, not much. I was just...

nodes.text: Brendan! What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I was just... Talking to Hector...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, you better not stay too long! You promised you'd help me run my lines, remember?
Hannah runs off.

nodes.text: Hey, Brendan? Can I ask you a personal question? Guy to guy?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Why do you let her boss you around like that, man?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Huh? Hannah? She doesn't boss me around!

nodes.speaker: Hector

nodes.text: It made total sense to me! He's a tough, intimidating warrior who goes around killing everyone.

nodes.text: ...Hmm.

nodes.text: M... Mona?

nodes.text: Yes, darling?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Gah! How did you get there?

nodes.text: That doesn't make any sense... But at least you're okay!
